item.text:
This round is recorded.

## Results

**Helper review completed.** I finished auditing every `cluster` helper in `testing.go`. None besides Finding 1 has the stale-snapshot pattern: `EnsureSame` and `WaitForReplication` re-read live state each pass, `GetInState` re-polls under a stability timer, `WaitForFollowers`/`Followers` delegate to `GetInState`, and `Partition`/`FullyConnect` only rewire transports. `EnsureLeader` is single-shot by design. So the helper defects are exactly Findings 1 and 2.

**Race detector clean.** Ran the in-memory suite under `-race` (skipping only the socket-dependent and known-flake tests):

```
go test -race -count=1 -skip 'HasExistingState|runFollower|Network|TCP' -timeout 600s .
ok  github.com/hashicorp/raft  134.114s        (0 "DATA RACE")
```

No data race surfaced in the concurrency-heavy core (leader loop, replication, commitment, log cache) — consistent with an authentic upstream build.

## State

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_12-07-16-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) now contains: Finding 1 (deterministically reproduced stale-snapshot defect in `EnsureSamePeers`) with causal isolation, Finding 2 (minor `EnsureSame` message bug), the suite-level flake hunt, the race-detector run, the authenticated-identity evidence, and the artifact index. Captured source is still untouched (`SOURCE_UNCHANGED_OK`), and replay scripts live under `work/.runtime/audit/` (`repro.sh`, `repro_ensurepeers.sh`, `repro_deterministic.sh`).

At this point the main module has been checked by four independent means — authenticated byte-identity, full-suite execution, a repeated suite-level flake hunt, and the race detector — and the only concrete defects are the two `testing.go` helper bugs.

If the budget continues, the remaining genuinely-unexplored surface is the two nested modules I couldn't authenticate or build offline (`fuzzy/`, `raft-compat/`); short of that, further work would be a semantics review of a specific core algorithm, which would report upstream (not injected) issues.
